rules: A relationship does not automatically reveal private facts.
NPCs cannot read the global relationship graph as knowledge.
Rumor is a claim channel and may be incomplete or wrong.
A witness may know that an interaction occurred without knowing private content.
Formal access to a record may convey only the authorized subset.
Confidential information may be remembered while remaining intentionally undisclosed.
The AI dialogue context receives only knowledge actually available to that NPC.
Campaign truth and character belief remain separate.
